scope: Eight complete new maker entries: Arduino2,Espressif3,RaspberryPi3. No existing entries edited.

validation.standalone: All three families import and pass registry validation; every contact has a nonempty description, unique stable ID/terminal, physical surface anchor and matching metal contact. Both SVG modes reviewed locally.
validation.nativeKiCad: Integrating agent verified all eight generated symbols and footprints through native KiCad CLI parsing and SVG export. Successful native export establishes format consistency, not production geometric accuracy.
validation.geometry: New pin anchors stable after initial importable definitions; old catalog geometry is owned and checked by integrating agent.
validation.sourceCADImport: Native KiCad import of the manufacturer Altium files failed on source layer mapping. Manufacturer Gerber/drill data and schematic diagrams were used directly for the recorded contacts; no failed import output was used as evidence.
validation.integration: Integrating agent reports final catalog608, all208 tests passed, all56 additions native KiCad checks passed, all112 SVG modes rendered, browser filters and PNG/SVG export checked, versioned build imports608. Existing552 entries remain unchanged.

notes: Manufacturer V0.3 Gerbers parsed for 14 header drill positions, 8 Qwiic solder-tail centers, 15 rear fixture pads and 4 grounded Qwiic retainers. Header J3.1…10 is PA2,GND,3V3,PF2,SWCLK,SWDIO,TX1,RX1,PA0,PA1; J4.1…4 GND,3V3,SDA,SCL.
Rear fixture pads have no printed numeric terminal IDs. Catalog TP.1…15 assign stable IDs; 7 wired and8 NC. Actual rear pads were paired with the mirrored source schematic test-point view.

Qwiic source solder tails are used as physical endpoints and labelled as such, not drawn as mating contacts. J1 opens toward native−X and pin1 is nativeY14.18; J2 opens toward+X and pin1 is nativeY11.18.
I²C address expressed as 7-bit0x3A; old datasheet also prints shifted value0x76.

contacts.description: USB D− test point, on the connector side of the USB interface. This is USB data, not a GPIO.

contacts.label: USB_DP
contacts.description: USB D+ test point, on the connector side of the USB interface. This is USB data, not a GPIO.

contacts.label: SMPS_PS
contacts.description: GPIO23 controls the onboard SMPS power-save mode. The manufacturer says not to use this point externally; changing it affects regulator behavior.

contacts.label: LED
contacts.description: GPIO25 LED drive node. External use is not recommended: this node swings only from ground to the LED forward voltage, not a full 3.3 V logic high.

contacts.label: BOOTSEL
contacts.description: QSPI chip-select / BOOTSEL test point. Short low during power-up to enter USB mass-storage boot mode; it is shared with flash operation.

contacts.label: 1V1
contacts.description: Internal nominal 1.1 V core-regulator test point. The manufacturer says not to use this point externally; it is not a peripheral supply.

entries.revision: SC1633 bare-header variant, Pico2W published mechanical/pin-numbering drawings
notes: 49 contacts=40 main+3 SWD+6 TP;4 USB shell pads repeat TP1 ground in native footprint. Main header centers and pitch match Pico2. SWD centers from manufacturer Fig5: bottom-origin (11.0841,19.8),(13.6241,19.8),(16.1641,19.8).
TP1/2/3 coordinates match Pico2. TP4/5/6 bottom-origin(8,41.5),(8,39),(8,36.5), labels verified Fig4; rear mirrorsX.
TP4 is WL_GPIO1/SMPS_PS; TP5 is WL_GPIO0 LED node with only LED-forward-voltage swing; neither is presented as an ordinary RP2350 GPIO. Separate power rails VBUS,VSYS,ADC_VREF retained.
No vendor STEP/CAD model was verified for Pico2W; no unrelated PicoW model link is attached.
entries.footprintEvidence: Source-coordinate contact reference: 40 header holes, three SWD contacts, all rear test points and four USB shell lands. Centers follow the manufacturer's dimension and SMT-reference drawings. Header/SWD lands are representative through-hole carrier pads; test and shell pads use source center locations. This is not the manufacturer's asymmetric SMT footprint or paste stencil, and is not a qualified production mating pattern. Generated 3D geometry is approximate.

notes: 35 contacts=26 TP+J4.1…3+J2.1…3+J3.1…3. TP4 is absent from source schematic and location diagram; no fabricated TP4. J4 GPIO0,GND,GPIO1; J2 TX,GND,RX; J3 CLK,GND,DIO.
Actual two target-port mating faces shown as enlarged insets, PCB below. Own RP2040 SWCLK/SWDIO are TP13/14 and remain separate from target-facing CLK/DIO. Target sockets have no power pin.
TP5/17/18/21/22 are loaded LED anode nodes after470 ohm resistors, not rawGPIO outputs. TP19 is5VVBUS, TP26 regulated3V3, TP27internal1V1. Boot/QSPI signal distinguished.

Rear coordinates scaled from manufacturer labelled raster source using22×32 mm mechanical outline; numerical precision does not establish CAD accuracy. J4/socket offsets and land shapes are representative. FP:R. Vendor mechanical PDF is linked explicitly as a drawing, not a3D STEP model.

contacts.description: USB D− test point on the connector side of a 27 Ω series resistor. USB data, not GPIO.

contacts.description: USB D+ test point on the connector side of a 27 Ω series resistor. USB data, not GPIO.

contacts.label: LED_RED
contacts.description: LED RED indicator anode, after a 470 Ω series resistor from RP2040 GPIO2. This is a loaded LED node, not a full logic-level GPIO output.
